comment:
* Implements a homogenous consistent linked list. All the objects in the linked * list must derive from the same root class. This is a useful constraint to * place on our code as this property is invariant.The list is created with the * superclass which can be specified as either a class name or a Class. * * @version 1.2 * * @author M. Ranganathan
* * *

methods.name: protected static boolean isCloneable(Object obj)
methods.comment: * Return true if this supports reflection based cloning.

methods.name: public Object clone()
methods.comment: * Makes a deep clone of this list.

methods.name: protected GenericObject next(ListIterator iterator)
methods.comment: * Traverse the list given a list iterator

methods.name: protected GenericObject first()
methods.comment:
* This is the default list iterator.This will not handle nested list
     * traversal.

methods.name: protected GenericObject next()
methods.comment: * Fetch the next object from the list based on the default list iterator

methods.name: protected void concatenate(GenericObjectList objList)
methods.comment:
* Concatenate two compatible header lists, adding the argument to the tail
     * end of this list.
     *
     * @param <var>
     *            topFlag </var> set to true to add items to top of list

methods.name: protected void concatenate(GenericObjectList objList, boolean topFlag)
methods.comment:
* Concatenate two compatible header lists, adding the argument either to
     * the beginning or the tail end of this list. A type check is done before
     * concatenation.
     *
     * @param <var>
     *            topFlag </var> set to true to add items to top of list else
     *            add them to the tail end of the list.

methods.name: public String encode()
methods.comment:
* Encode the list in semicolon separated form.
     *
     * @return an encoded string containing the objects in this list.
     * @since v1.0

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment: * Alias for the encode function above.

methods.name: public void setSeparator(String sep)
methods.comment:
* Set the separator (for encoding the list)
     *
     * @since v1.0
     * @param sep
     *            is the new seperator (default is semicolon)

methods.name: public int hashCode()
methods.comment: * Hash code. We never expect to put this in a hash table so return a constant.

methods.name: public boolean equals(Object other)
methods.comment:
* Equality checking predicate.
     *
     * @param other
     *            is the object to compare ourselves to.
     * @return true if the objects are equal.

methodNames: protected void concatenate(GenericObjectList objList, boolean topFlag)
